description: Gas price and fee estimate. Current gas price, base fee, suggested priority fee and EIP-1559 maxFee for Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism, plus a 21000-gas transfer cost in native units. Deterministic, no LLM. Example output: {"chain":"base","block":1,"gasPriceGwei":"0.01","baseFeeGwei":"0.005","priorityFeeGwei":"0.001","maxFeeGwei":"0.011","transferCostEth":"0.00000021"}. Price: $0.001 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).
